limitations: Disconnected zero-thickness LCD edge triangles duplicated in the source export are omitted; two complete source LCD faces and outer panel are retained.
Runtime board/peripherals are not implemented for this SKU; geometry preview does not establish firmware compatibility.
Photo and geometry comparisons remain partial; no complete 1:1 manufacturing or populated-PCB certification.
Source CAD MIT and manufacturer photographs have distinct rights; no separate open photo license verified.
Blank display rectangle uses documented active dimensions when available; placement/window boundary is estimated from photos/CAD, not a calibrated measurement.

Source file contains upper core frame/glass/keys; matching bottom battery base geometry is absent. Reassembled upper core is shallower than the17mm complete-product specification, a retained dimension failure.
Glass/key seating is an explicitly estimated rigid assembly. Port mouths are photo-derived and no physical fit is certified.
Back photograph includes missing battery base, so it is not a like-for-like silhouette comparison. Side comparison shows separated base and cannot certify assembled thickness.
cameraNotes: Camera scale/center calibrated to original official silhouette and independent body dimensions; no geometry rescaling.

observations: Manufacturer shell triangles retain source dimensions; this visual-review harness uses blank framebuffer surfaces and does not execute firmware.

Default, gold and translucent purple front/back renders inspected. Paper labels are independent explicitly masked source-photo layers; shell recoloring does not paint them or screen/connector material. Products without a label texture make no claim that missing text has been reconstructed.
UNKNOWN board placeholders remain explicit. Photo-derived visible connector inserts do not establish contact fit or electrical routing.
limitations: Raw silhouette tests retain failures. Oblique source views, white-on-white segmentation, annotations/coins and uncertain camera pose can make this metric inconclusive; no failed metric is promoted to a precision pass.
